statements.status_notes: CVE-2026-28389 ("Possible NULL Dereference When Processing CMS KeyAgreeRecipientInfo") affects OpenSSL 3.5 and is fixed in OpenSSL 3.5.6: https://openssl-library.org/news/secadv/20260407.txt, fix on the openssl-3.5 branch https://github.com/openssl/openssl/commit/16cea4188e0ea567deb4f93f85902247e67384f5. Alpine lists it fixed in openssl 3.5.6-r0 (https://security.alpinelinux.org/vuln/CVE-2026-28389). The published DHI Alpine 3.23 openssl builds are 3.5.4-r0, 3.5.5-r0, 3.5.5_git20260330-r1, 3.5.6-r0, 3.5.6-r1, 3.5.7-r0, 3.5.7-r1, 3.5.8-r0, 3.5.8-r1, 3.5.9-r0, 3.5.9-r1 and 3.5.9-r2. 3.5.4-r0 and 3.5.5-r0 are OpenSSL 3.5.4 and 3.5.5 releases, and 3.5.5_git20260330-r1 is OpenSSL 3.5.5 with only the CVE-2026-2673 fix added, so none of the three carries this fix. 3.5.6-r0 and every later build are based on OpenSSL 3.5.6 or later.
